description: A seven-channel precision adder: each row contributes either the signal patched into it or, with nothing patched, a steady voltage of its own, and the seven are added together at one output

params.text: Sets what its row contributes: with a cable in that row's jack it scales that signal from 0 to 1, and with the jack empty it is a steady 0V to 1V instead
Chooses the sign of its row, + adding it to the total and - subtracting it
Takes its row out of the total; the lamp lit means that row is muted
Holds the output at 0V whatever the seven rows are doing; the lamp lit means the module is muted

inputs.text: The signal for its row, scaled by that row's knob and then added to or subtracted from the total

outputs.text: The seven rows added together, one channel

notes: the module arrives silent. All seven row mutes and the overall mute come up switched on, so the output is held at 0V until those eight lamps are clicked off.
a row with an empty jack contributes a steady voltage of 0V to 1V set by its knob, added or subtracted. That is what the module is for: seven unpatched rows can build a precise offset.
the module is monophonic. Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and the output carries one channel.
